name: s1000d-4.1-proced
description: S1000D Issue 4.1 procedures, validated against the installed official 4.1 schemas. Case 01 is the evaluator's test file; its six defects were confirmed by a real run. The other cases are derived from its corrected version (02) using knowledge of the 4.1 schema; if the official schema disagrees, the scorecard shows it and the case is corrected.
